answer: Sybil resistance by pricing identity in deliverable collateral. Each agent escrows walnut futures before attestations carry weight; the chain rejects votes from under-collateralized accounts. When a gale of signups raises arrivals past the calm threshold, collateral doubles per cohort: n puppets pay doubled bonds, linear in n, no bulk discount, honest users post one. Collateral binds to genesis height, which cannot be reset or pre-aged in parallel. Accounts may wander across cohorts, but vesting follows genesis, so moving resets nothing. Early withdrawal burns contracts.
